create_directory_mkdir_p: create a directory at the given path using mkdir_p equivalent to mkdir -p
find_max_iteration_searchForMaxIteration: find the maximum iteration number from filenames in a folder using searchForMaxIteration
get_last_ply_path: get the last point cloud ply file path from an input directory using get_last_ply_path
